name: How do I choose between different contractors for my luxury home expansion project?
description: Choose a contractor for luxury home expansion based on their experience with high-end projects, portfolio, client testimonials, and detailed proposals.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between different contractors for my luxury home expansion project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for a luxury home expansion, focus on their experience with similar high-end projects, their portfolio of past work, and client testimonials. It's important to assess their understanding of luxury finishes, custom millwork, and complex architectural details. Request detailed proposals that outline the scope of work, timeline, and cost breakdown. Also, consider their communication style and ability to work collaboratively with architects and designers, as a successful luxury expansion often involves a highly coordinated effort.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor for luxury home expansion based on their experience with high-end projects, portfolio, client testimonials, and detailed proposals.
